page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.48xlarge is an enterprise-level instance belonging to the general-purpose g9ae instance family. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture, this virtual machine provides 192 dedicated vCPUs driven by an AMD EPYC 9T95 processor clocked at a base frequency of 2.25 GHz. It includes 768.0 GB of system memory, matching the standard general-purpose ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance delivers a robust network profile featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps. It contains no onboard GPUs and does not come bundled with local storage disks, requiring external cloud block storage volumes for persistent data and operating system execution. Additionally, it provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, operating entirely within assigned VPC networking environments by default.

From an infrastructure and efficiency perspective, the massive core density and 1:4 compute-to-memory configuration offer high resource consolidation for large-scale multi-threaded workloads. Cost efficiency is realized through the aggregation of extensive computing resources within a single instance, though operational costs require factoring in external storage attachments.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.48xlarge is suited for heavy general-purpose enterprise tasks that demand large core counts and high network throughput. Primary workloads include distributed enterprise applications, in-memory caching tiers, large-scale container orchestration nodes, backend web serving clusters, and large data processing pipelines.
